title: J1: JMAP contact id encoding for MIMI user URIs
description: RFC 8620 Ids exclude ':' and '/', so mimi://a.example/u/alice cannot be a ChatContact id. Recommended: id = unpadded base64url of the user URI (fits while URI <= 191 bytes; else a hash), login = the URI. PENDING Mark (from the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18); decide when mimid-1wgh.13 is planned.
